issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'đành bỏ mình' (gave themselves up/abandoned themselves) is slightly different from the Greek 'παρεδωκαν' (handed over/delivered over), but more importantly, the phrase 'mất cả sự cảm biết' is not present in the Greek text provided. The Greek starts directly with 'οιτινες απηλγηκοτες' (who, being [people who]...).

The Vietnamese 'để làm ra đủ mọi thứ lợi' (to produce all kinds of benefits) is a significant addition/interpretation. The Greek 'εις εργασιαν ακαθαρσιας πασης' means 'into the work of all uncleanness.' The Vietnamese adds a concept of 'profit/benefit' (lợi) that is not in the Greek.
